scenarios.name: Version and schema
scenarios.stimulus: Valid and unsupported versions; missing/extra fields
scenarios.expected: Valid accepted; malformed rejected; no fallback

scenarios.name: Tenant isolation
scenarios.stimulus: Same IDs under a different authenticated project
scenarios.expected: No cross-project read/write or side effect
scenarios.evidence: integration test with two real test identities

scenarios.name: Missing or forged credentials
scenarios.stimulus: No bearer, expired token, forged caller role
scenarios.expected: 401/403; never trust client roles

scenarios.name: Idempotent duplicate
scenarios.stimulus: 20 identical concurrent POSTs then service restart and repeat
scenarios.expected: One logical job; original identity returned after restart

scenarios.name: Idempotent payload conflict
scenarios.stimulus: Same key with changed request body
scenarios.expected: 409 without extra provider call

scenarios.name: Cancellation and restart
scenarios.stimulus: Cancel queued/running job; kill/restart process
scenarios.expected: No new calls after cancellation; terminal status retained

scenarios.name: Finite nested retries
scenarios.stimulus: Inject 429/503, timeout, 401 and validation failures
scenarios.expected: All retries share budget/deadline; auth/invalid payload not retried

scenarios.name: Budget reservation
scenarios.stimulus: Concurrent calls approach max tokens/requests/cost
scenarios.expected: No over-reservation; ambiguous charged calls remain accounted

scenarios.name: Artifact integrity and path
scenarios.stimulus: Expired URL, wrong hash, traversal, same filename different bytes
scenarios.expected: Refresh URL safely; refuse corruption/escape/collision

scenarios.name: Untrusted text
scenarios.stimulus: Source/model text contains tool instructions and URLs
scenarios.expected: Not executed; does not overwrite system policy
scenarios.evidence: injection test with observed side effects

scenarios.name: Reproducible delivery
scenarios.stimulus: Fresh checkout/build image, no local caches
scenarios.expected: Same declared source; lockfile and artifact hash; no embedded secret

scenarios.name: Warnings and failure truth
scenarios.stimulus: Build/runtime warnings, skipped tests, upstream unavailability
scenarios.expected: Report warnings/skips and truthful NOT_RUN; no fake green status

scenarios.name: Provider normalization
scenarios.stimulus: Known OpenSEO protocol response fixture
scenarios.expected: Expected ResearchResult with provenance retained

scenarios.name: Actual provider probe
scenarios.stimulus: Owner-authorized scoped keyword/SERP read
scenarios.expected: Recorded capability/version/auth and measured result

scenarios.name: Null versus zero
scenarios.stimulus: No volume/difficulty returned
scenarios.expected: Null+MISSING, never fabricated numeric 0

scenarios.name: Locale binding
scenarios.stimulus: Same keyword with VN/vi and different locale
scenarios.expected: Separate provider requests/cache; scope retained

scenarios.name: Freshness and metric scale
scenarios.stimulus: Stale source and metrics using different scales
scenarios.expected: Mark stale; document conversion; timestamp preserved

scenarios.name: Vietnamese duplicate handling
scenarios.stimulus: Unicode/diacritic/whitespace variants
scenarios.expected: Document normalization, preserve meaning and display text

scenarios.name: Competitor provenance
scenarios.stimulus: SERP includes text and source URL
scenarios.expected: No competitor prose copied into a draft or technical fact DB

scenarios.name: Intent grouping
scenarios.stimulus: Related terms with distinct buying/informational intent
scenarios.expected: Clusters retain intent boundaries and rationale

scenarios.name: Product scope
scenarios.stimulus: Lever hoist, electric hoist and hand chain hoist mix
scenarios.expected: Off-pilot candidates flagged, not silently merged

scenarios.name: Existing page collision
scenarios.stimulus: Topic already covered in existing_pages
scenarios.expected: Update/cannibalization recommendation, no duplicate forced brief

scenarios.name: Calendar not publication
scenarios.stimulus: Change proposed_publish_at
scenarios.expected: Revision updates; no publish call triggered

scenarios.name: Complete brief
scenarios.stimulus: Research with required user goals
scenarios.expected: All agreed brief fields populated; evidence needs explicit

scenarios.name: Cache optimization
scenarios.stimulus: Repeat equivalent research within permitted freshness
scenarios.expected: Avoid redundant paid requests; source age still visible

scenarios.name: Provider rate limits
scenarios.stimulus: 429 Retry-After then recovery
scenarios.expected: Bounded retry honors wait and job deadline

scenarios.name: Provider schema drift
scenarios.stimulus: Tool missing or unexpected response
scenarios.expected: Fail closed or visible degraded mode; never invented metrics

scenarios.name: Malicious SERP text
scenarios.stimulus: SERP asks agent to upload keys or change policy
scenarios.expected: Untrusted content isolated; no secret/side effect

scenarios.name: Stable revision outputs
scenarios.stimulus: Replay same snapshot/version and reordered provider items
scenarios.expected: Stable canonical brief identity where semantics identical

scenarios.name: Actual consumer compatibility
scenarios.stimulus: Vendor 1 emitted brief supplied to Vendor 2 fixture client
scenarios.expected: No field renaming or silent defaults

scenarios.name: Brief intake
scenarios.stimulus: Valid actual Vendor 1 output
scenarios.expected: Writer consumes unchanged brief revision

scenarios.name: Missing or held evidence
scenarios.stimulus: No eligible claims, HOLD, QUARANTINE
scenarios.expected: REVIEW_REQUIRED/gaps, no invented factual block

scenarios.name: Citation semantics
scenarios.stimulus: Paraphrase with wrong negation/unit/model despite valid ID
scenarios.expected: Detect or block; reference-ID validity not treated as entailment

scenarios.name: Scope and jurisdiction
scenarios.stimulus: Foreign rule or different OEM model
scenarios.expected: No unsupported THBISON/VN generalization

scenarios.name: Source prompt injection
scenarios.stimulus: Evidence tells model to ignore restrictions
scenarios.expected: Instruction ignored; source remains data

scenarios.name: Model invalid output
scenarios.stimulus: Malformed JSON/timeouts/provider unavailable
scenarios.expected: Bounded retries, schema error visible, no fake completed article

scenarios.name: Approval invalidation
scenarios.stimulus: Edit body, SEO field, destination or evidence snapshot
scenarios.expected: Old approval cannot publish

scenarios.name: Approval authorization
scenarios.stimulus: Model/caller supplies approved=true or another user ID
scenarios.expected: Server rejects; only role-authenticated approval accepted

scenarios.name: Out-of-scope safety/legal text
scenarios.stimulus: Attempt publish safety/legal draft in pilot
scenarios.expected: Publication blocked and reason visible

scenarios.name: Revoked evidence
scenarios.stimulus: Source revoked after preview/approval
scenarios.expected: Re-check source/policy blocks publication

scenarios.name: Rendered preview and sources
scenarios.stimulus: Complete synthetic article
scenarios.expected: Readable preview plus functional per-block source links

scenarios.name: Desktop and mobile UX
scenarios.stimulus: 1440x900 and 390x844 viewport flows
scenarios.expected: No clipped editor/calendar; mock/live state visible; store untouched

scenarios.name: XSS and unsafe rendering
scenarios.stimulus: Malicious HTML/URL in provider/user/model text
scenarios.expected: Sanitized output, no script execution or unsafe navigation

scenarios.name: Timezone and duplicate tick
scenarios.stimulus: Aware date displayed Bangkok, repeated scheduler tick
scenarios.expected: One due operation; naive times rejected; no early publish

scenarios.name: CMS accepted but response lost
scenarios.stimulus: Provider creates draft then network times out
scenarios.expected: UNKNOWN then reconcile; no blind new create

scenarios.name: Publishing replay
scenarios.stimulus: Retry same approved version after restart
scenarios.expected: Same provider record; no duplicate post

scenarios.name: Unauthorized destination/write scope
scenarios.stimulus: Wrong site/page; protected Notion human fields
scenarios.expected: Deny write; preserve original human fields

scenarios.name: Social summary
scenarios.stimulus: Approved article -> Facebook Page summary
scenarios.expected: Not full copy; meaning/link retained; posting flag OFF

scenarios.name: Sensitive logs
scenarios.stimulus: Tokens, signed URLs and internal review notes in errors
scenarios.expected: No secret leakage in logs/browser/build artifact

scenarios.name: Concurrent editing
scenarios.stimulus: Two writers update same article revision
scenarios.expected: Conflict visible; no silent lost update

scenarios.name: File roundtrip
scenarios.stimulus: Notion attachment expires or upload partly fails
scenarios.expected: Recover via gateway; retain outbox; verify before success

scenarios.name: Rollback and compensation
scenarios.stimulus: App rollback after draft creation
scenarios.expected: No accidental unpublish/delete; data/IDs preserved

scenarios.name: Admission performance
scenarios.stimulus: 100 local admission requests at concurrency 5
scenarios.expected: p95 <= 1000ms without provider work in request handler

scenarios.name: Cached brief latency
scenarios.stimulus: 100 warmed-up read requests
scenarios.expected: p95 <= 500ms; no paid provider call

scenarios.name: Preview latency
scenarios.stimulus: 10k-character fixture, cached render path
scenarios.expected: p95 <= 2000ms excluding new generation

scenarios.name: Concurrency effects
scenarios.stimulus: 20 repeats plus different jobs
scenarios.expected: Correct duplicate suppression and budget under load

scenarios.name: Measured optimization
scenarios.stimulus: Compare initial working baseline vs final on same inputs
scenarios.expected: Declared metric improves >=15% or mark NOT_MET; correctness unchanged

scenarios.name: Resource and disk failure
scenarios.stimulus: Disk/outbox quota, OOM or provider outage
scenarios.expected: Truthful terminal/recoverable state; no success before save

scenarios.name: Build host portability
scenarios.stimulus: Fresh Linux and supported dev host checkouts
scenarios.expected: Hash/newline/path behavior consistent; no global Git setting hack

scenarios.name: Three-boundary rehearsal
scenarios.stimulus: Actual vendor services with synthetic Knowledge and CMS
scenarios.expected: Research->brief->evidence->preview->mock publication with trace IDs
scenarios.evidence: end-to-end test using actual delivered images
